defect1_calibrationThrash.status: CLOSED IN PRIVATE PROBE HELPER (CPU-proved), NOT RUN HEADED
defect1_calibrationThrash.confirmedMechanism: walkTowards.runCalibration (earned-continue-3d-probe.mjs:439-483) latched basisUp from ONE cgSnap taken BEFORE four 450ms ordinary key presses, then compared that pre-round latch against live up in the steering loop (:508) with basisStale maxTiltDeg=12.
defect1_calibrationThrash.rootCause: The calibration round's own ~7.5 units of ordinary walking across a curved face rotated up by 32.49 deg, which is >12 deg, so the very next loop pass declared the just-taken basis stale and calibrated again. Self-sustaining loop.

designAdopted.perKeyLiveUp: each key direction is stamped with the up measured at ITS OWN post-burst snapshot (upAtSample), never a pre-round latch
designAdopted.retentionThroughSmoothFaceChange: a stored 3D direction is retained while its own upAtSample is within 45 deg of current AND it still projects usably into the CURRENT plane; chooseKey3d already re-projects on every use
designAdopted.retentionBoundRationale: 12 deg was a whole-basis latch test. The measured smooth change was 32.49 deg, so a 12 deg per-key bound would discard directions that still steer correctly and would reproduce the thrash. 45 deg keeps a direction only while its in-plane component is dominant.
designAdopted.steerabilityVsFreshness: anyUsableNow is computed from whether ANY stored direction still projects usably now, NOT from whether any key is fresh. Conflating them was what let a merely-stale basis bypass the motion guard and re-trigger calibration.
designAdopted.meaningfulDirectedMotionGuard: recalibrationDecision refuses while unitsSinceLastCalibration < minUnitsSinceCalib (default 6u, ~3x the measured 1.878u a calibration round induces) as long as some key still steers
designAdopted.partialRecalibration: only keys that actually went stale are re-measured
designAdopted.shortDisplacement: unitsSinceLastCalibration is accumulated from REAL foot displacement (accumulateDirected); no motion is invented
designAdopted.noForbiddenMechanism: no teleport, no pose setter, no autopilot, no rail, no enlarged timeout, no widened arrival radius
